entries.title: Why can't gain envelope control points be deleted in Audacity 4?
entries.description: I added gain envelope control points on an audio clip. According to the Audacity 4 documentation, envelopes are a visual layer toggled via the Automation button, and gain envelopes are clip-based — they stay with the clip when moved or copied.
